visualCharacteristics.purpose: numbered process stepper whose steps expand independently
visualCharacteristics.layout: vertical list with a progress rail; each step shows thumbnail, eyebrow and title

contentPattern.structure: label cell (optional thumbnail image, 'Step N' eyebrow paragraph, title) | body cell (description paragraph)
contentPattern.interactive: independent expand/collapse per step, first step open by default; progress rail fills to the last open step

suitableFor: onboarding or treatment journeys with a short description per step
notSuitableFor: FAQ lists without a step sequence or thumbnails (use accordion)
